subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw approve agent schema version 12 and the permanent public/operator contract for retrieving ACP parent-relay diagnostics after `streamLogPath` is removed?
rationale: This selects a persistent data-model upgrade and an externally observable diagnostic contract; neither can safely be inferred from tests or an internal table alone.

options.title: Require supported diagnostics retrieval and schema acceptance
options.body: Keep the migration but add a documented stable retrieval/export path for accepted ACP runs and record explicit approval for the v12 agent schema.

options.title: Keep file-path compatibility temporarily
options.body: Preserve `streamLogPath` until a stable SQLite-backed diagnostic API is designed and documented.

options.title: Defer the ACP portion
options.body: Land only independent audit-journal work later and postpone the per-agent ACP storage migration until its contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Require supported diagnostics retrieval and schema acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the migration but add a documented stable retrieval/export path for accepted ACP runs and record explicit approval for the v12 agent schema.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite migration is the closest established ownership trail for the per-agent storage contract being extended.
